parties: RPG Life Sciences Limited (transferor) and RPG Active Pharma Limited (transferee)
headline: RPG Life Sciences completes API Business Transfer to RPG Active Pharma
sum: RPG Life Sciences has completed the transfer of its Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API) business to its group company RPG Active Pharma Limited, in line with an earlier Business Transfer Agreement (BTA), as disclosed via NSE intimation on 15 August 2026.
implication: Intra-group pharma reorganisations triggering Schedule VI asset transfer & continuity of employee obligations; review if any contract consents / intellectual property licences were implicit in the BTA structure.
detail: RPG Life Sciences executed and completed a BTA to transfer its API business division to RPG Active Pharma Limited, a fellow group entity. The transfer involved the hiving-off of active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing, asset and liability operations. This is a restructuring within the RPG pharmaceutical conglomerate designed to consolidate API capabilities under a dedicated subsidiary. No acquisition price or consideration amount was publicly disclosed in the filing; typical of intra-group transfers, these are often effected at book value or via inter-corporate debt. Regulatory approval (if required under MCA / stock exchange rules for related-party transactions) is not explicitly stated in the available disclosure.

framework.note: Intra-group transfers may invoke statutory scheme process if shareholders' approval / court sanction is triggered; status unclear from filing.

framework.ref: Companies Act 2013, Schedule VI (Transfer of Undertaking)
framework.note: Core framework for asset, liability and employee continuity in business transfers; successor company assumes all obligations.

framework.ref: Bharatiya Labour Suraksha Samhita (BLSS) 2023, Chapter IX (Industrial Relations)
framework.note: Amended employment continuity & worker rights on transfer; applicable to BTA involving employee handover.

framework.ref: Drugs and Cosmetics Act 1940, Section 21 (Manufacturing Licences)
framework.note: API manufacturing is subject to state-level licensing; transfer may require fresh or amended manufacturing licence for transferee.

framework.ref: SEBI Listing Regulations 2015, Regulation 30 (Disclosure of Material Events)
framework.note: Related-party transactions and business transfers require timely disclosure; NSE filing evidences compliance.
If BTA is treated as related-party transaction (both entities under common RPG holding), RPT approval framework applies.
Third-party consents (customer, supplier, licensor consents to assignment) are typical conditions precedent in BTAs; not disclosed.

framework.ref: Intellectual Property Rights (Patents Act 1970, Trademark Act 1999)
framework.note: Transfer of process patents, trademark licenses and confidential formulae central to API business value; assignment mechanics typically covered in BTA.
